source.reviewMethod: Committed saved profiles were compared with detected candidate faces in local derivatives. Zero-tag photos were also reviewed as complete images, repeated faces were grouped across photos, and lower-score confirmations required matching same-day visual context. Wedding originals were not opened or changed. Recurring unnamed clusters are promoted only when Zach selects an attendee in the private local tagger; those human decisions do not depend on model similarity.

reviewWaves.reviewType: Exhaustive review of zero-tag photos with detected faces
reviewWaves.reviewMethod: Reviewed every full-photo overview and every clustering-eligible face comparison, sorted repeated detections into same-face clusters, and used tagged same-day photos only as corroborating visual context.
reviewWaves.heldBackReason: Candidates not approved were mismatches, duplicate-person detections in one photo, unknown recurring faces, or too distant, blurred, occluded, or back-facing to identify safely.

reviewWaves.reviewType: Widened bucket (b) sweep: face-size floor lowered from 0.035 to 0.015
reviewWaves.reviewMethod: audit-archive-tags.py was re-run with --min-untagged-face-frac 0.015 and --min-untagged-det-score 0.60, writing a separate report so the calibrated baseline was untouched. All 109 strong-tier candidates were rendered as saved profile beside candidate face and reviewed. Candidates too dark to judge were held on a measured luminance floor rather than on score, the Parker/Riley Soskin lookalike pair was held for an explicit human call, and pairs an earlier wave had already rejected were left rejected. Wedding originals were opened read-only for rendering and were not changed.

reviewWaves.reviewType: Maura Keith Gutierrez, identified from a human-picked anchor face
reviewWaves.reviewMethod: Her stored profile is Chris Gutierrez, so no profile match could find her. Zach picked her face off a contact sheet of the photos tagged to her without Chris; that face was then matched across the archive. Eleven faces came back and Zach confirmed all eleven, nine of which fall in photos already tagged to her. These are the two that were not yet tagged. Scores are against that anchor face, not a centroid.
reviewWaves.dependsOn: The maura-keith-gutierrez profile defect recorded on wave 6 is still unfixed; her saved face still shows Chris until a crop is framed at /admin/faces.

reviewWaves.reviewType: Candidates surfaced by the rebuilt signatures
reviewWaves.reviewMethod: Rebuilding signatures after waves 5-7 resolved 118 of 132 tagged people, up from 108, and gave Chris Gutierrez a signature for the first time. These are the untagged faces that appeared at the calibrated default thresholds as a result. Zach reviewed all fifteen as saved profile beside proposed face and denied the two Jorie Soskin rows.

reviewWaves.reviewType: Widened sweep re-run on the rebuilt profiles
reviewWaves.reviewMethod: The default-threshold pass had converged to nothing new, but the widened one had not been re-run since the signatures were rebuilt. Re-running it with the face-size floor at 0.015 and the detector floor at 0.60 surfaced 22 candidates, 6 of which earlier waves had already decided and were left alone. Zach reviewed the remaining 16 as saved profile beside proposed face and approved all of them. Nine are people who only gained a signature in the last two rebuilds, so no earlier sweep could have proposed them.

reviewWaves.reviewType: Human identity assignment for recurring unnamed face clusters
reviewWaves.reviewMethod: Zach selected one wedding-roster identity for a privately reviewed same-face cluster. The assignment propagates only to the photographs represented in that cluster and does not depend on a model-similarity threshold.

reviewWaves.reviewType: Danny Listrani, identified from a human-picked anchor face
reviewWaves.reviewMethod: Zach spotted him in the tagger and named the face. He had no profile and no cluster, so nothing could ever have proposed him: his best match against all 131 existing profiles was 0.142, which is noise. The face was matched across the archive and every hit reviewed as a contact sheet. He now has a hand-picked anchor so the next rebuild can learn him properly.

reviewWaves.reviewType: Candidates surfaced by the 2026-08-05 signature rebuild
reviewWaves.reviewMethod: Signatures were stale against the human waves 10 and 11, so they were rebuilt: resolution rose from 118 of 132 tagged people to 138 of 152, and Danny Listrani gained a learned profile from the anchor wave 11 left him. The widened sweep was re-run on the rebuilt profiles and all 21 rows at or above 0.48 similarity and 0.08 margin were rendered as saved profile beside proposed face. Zach reviewed the four contact sheets and confirmed all 21. Six of them reverse his own earlier denials, which is expected: those were denied against profiles that have since been rebuilt or, in Danny Listrani's case, did not exist. Wedding originals were opened read-only for rendering and were not changed.

profileDefectFound.detail: The rebuild gave this slug the archive's three highest untagged matches (0.786, 0.773, 0.728). Every face in its learned cluster is a woman with a chin-length bob; Zach confirmed Mike Caron is a heavyset man, which is who his committed saved face shows. The three rows were removed from this wave before review and the slug is now recorded in metadata/face-profile-corrections.json, so it carries no recognition profile at all. The woman in cluster c0259 recurs across 5 photographs and is still unnamed.

reviewWaves.reviewType: Dominique Caron, identified from the cluster that had mislabelled the mike-caron profile
reviewWaves.reviewMethod: The wave-12 profile correction dropped learned cluster c0259 from mike-caron after every face in it proved to be a woman. Her five faces were matched across the archive from that cluster centroid and rendered as a contact sheet. Zach reviewed it and identified her as Dominique Caron, seated guest, previously zero tagged photographs, and Mike Caron's companion in the couple photograph tagged only with his name. Same defect shape as Chris and Maura Gutierrez: a couple photographed together where only one identity ever resolved, so co-occurrence handed her face to his name.
